svg.title: A negative charge moving in a circle in a magnetic field
svg.desc: A magnetic field B points into the page, shown by a grid of circled crosses. A negative charge −q moves clockwise around a circle. It is drawn at five points around the circle: at each, its velocity v is a green arrow tangent to the circle and the magnetic force F is a red arrow pointing toward the center, so the velocity changes direction but not magnitude.
